attempts.prompt: 画一个亚刻奥特曼月亮装甲本人完整的2D街机像素人物，单张、单人、透明背景。附图只作本人身份与头身比例参考，不复制站姿。保留银白后掠头冠、黄眼、蓝青胸肩甲、胸前圆灯、两腕圆盘装甲和红银腿部。画向右攻击的回旋重击初段：解剖左腿唯一承重，脚掌前部贴地、脚跟轻提，膝略屈；右腿离地，右大腿抬至腰附近、膝弯约90度，小腿自然收在膝后下方，尚未伸腿。肩带与骨盆真实扭转，躯干四分之三侧身但仍可辨斜向胸面，头回看右侧，双臂弯曲护头胸，双腕圆甲跟随前臂透视。必须是同一完整身体，恰好两条腿两条臂，不是全正面站姿或水平侧踢。不臆造大面积背甲。完整头冠、双拳、支撑脚和收起的右脚留在画布内，身份比例一致；像素边缘、硬阶阴影、深轮廓。不得出现对手、场景、地线、文字、箭头、特效、光晕或影子。

attempts.prompt: A single complete 2D arcade pixel-art frame of the same Luna Armor Ultraman Arc in reference 1, isolated on a truly transparent background. Side-view facing right. This is a turning preparation frame, NOT a static single-knee raise: his planted LEFT support foot is clearly PIVOTING ON THE BALL OF THE FOOT with heel visibly RAISED above the ground, bent left knee and hips over the toe. His RIGHT knee is bent and raised at waist height with the lower leg folded back, still not kicking. The pelvis is visibly rotating toward a three-quarter back view while the chest is turned to a different angle, with only a narrow oblique strip of the chest armor still visible: show shoulder and hip rotation through full-body anatomy, not by rotating a standing sprite. His head looks right, both hands protect face/chest, both wrist disks present and attached. Use the same swept silver crest, yellow eye, cyan chest/shoulder armor, round chest light and red-silver limbs of reference 1; avoid inventing rear armor. Retain complete head, fists, both legs and both feet with generous margins, exactly two anatomically connected arms and legs. Crisp hard pixel edges and cel shading, no background, floor line, aura, glow, shadow, text, opponent or particles. Reference 2 was too frontal and planted the entire support sole; correct both issues.
